page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance within the ecs.c6 server family, operating on a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The server provides 24 vCPUs mapped across 12 dedicated physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 48 GB, offering a 2 GB per vCPU ratio that aligns with compute-dense hardware profiles. Cache specifications include 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Supported hardware features include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. This instance has no attached local storage and does not include GPU accelerators. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluation shows average multi-core CPU efficiency contrasted by lower single-core throughput. Single-core tests yield a stress-ng score of 1313.3 and a gzip compression speed of 22.86 GB/sec, placing single-threaded performance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Conversely, multi-threaded execution benefits from the 24 vCPUs, recording a multi-core stress-ng result of 21007.3, a Geekbench multi-core score of 8967.0, and a Passmark CPU score of 21643.62. Memory throughput measures 108.94 GB/sec for uncached 256MB block reads and 47.99 GB/sec for large block writes. Application benchmarks demonstrate baseline operational capacity, with Redis processing 20.09 million SET operations per second and static web serving achieving 15.86 GB/sec throughput.

Resource allocation on ecs.c6.6xlarge favors thread density over memory capacity, making it a cost-efficient selection for compute-heavy applications that do not require large memory footprints. Because no local SSD storage is included, deployment relies entirely on attached network storage solutions. High core availability combined with AVX-512 VNNI support makes the instance well-suited for multi-threaded batch processing, software compilation workloads using Clang, parallel web serving, and intermediate microservices layers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance offering 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores and 48 GB of memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz with 35 MB of L3 cache, it supports instruction sets like AVX-512 VNNI and AES. The instance features a 2:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and zero local storage. Benchmark testing indicates average multi-core CPU and memory performance, including a multi-core stress-ng score of 21007.3, a Geekbench multi-core score of 8967.0, and 20.09 million Redis SET operations per second, contrasted by weaker single-core scores. Designed for multi-threaded parallel execution without heavy memory requirements, ecs.c6.6xlarge provides a balanced compute-dense environment suited for software compilation, batch processing, and web serving.
